market_positioning.target_market: Dual B2B and B2C market, covering security service, outdoor recreation, hunting gear, and tactical supply industries. Primary regional markets include North America, EU, Oceania, and the Middle East with high demand for low-light observation equipment.
market_positioning.target_customer: B2B: Small to medium security service providers, outdoor gear importers/distributors, hunting equipment retailers, tactical gear suppliers, purchasing in bulk for resale or operational use, prioritizing durability, performance, and cost efficiency. B2C: Professional hunters, hardcore outdoor adventurers, tactical hobbyists seeking reliable personal night observation gear.
market_positioning.price_positioning: Mid-range to premium. Rationale: The product features IP67 protection, extreme temperature resistance, multiple mounting options, and reliable low-light recognition performance, outperforming entry-level economy monoculars while remaining affordable for bulk procurement and high-end individual consumers.
market_positioning.differentiation: Key differentiators include interchangeable left/right eye use, dual handheld/helmet mount compatibility, built-in strong light protection and auxiliary lighting, ultra-light 322g weight, wide -40℃ to +40℃ operating temperature range, and 100m+ pedestrian recognition distance in no-moon conditions, which are absent in most competing entry-level monoculars.

core_selling_points.title: Ultra-Light Compact Portable Design
core_selling_points.description: Easy to carry for long hours of use without causing fatigue, fits conveniently in pockets or small tactical pouches for on-demand access.
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Display the monocular placed next to an adult palm or standard CR123A battery to visually highlight its small, lightweight form factor.

core_selling_points.title: Dual Handheld & Helmet Mount Compatibility
core_selling_points.description: Flexible for both static handheld observation and hands-free helmet mounted use during mobile operations, adapting to varied usage needs.
core_selling_points.evidence: Product supports both handheld and helmet connection as listed in functional features
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Split hero image showing one side of the frame with a user holding the monocular, the other side with it mounted on a tactical helmet.

core_selling_points.title: Superior Low-Light Observation Performance
core_selling_points.description: Delivers clear target recognition even in extreme no-moon starlight conditions, supporting effective night time operation for users.
core_selling_points.evidence: ≥100m recognition distance for standing pedestrians, ≥150m for mid-sized vehicles under no-moon sky, 1x magnification, ≥40° field of view
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Side-by-side comparison graphic showing the blurred naked eye view of a dark scene next to the clear view through the PVS116 monocular.

core_selling_points.title: IP67 Rated All-Weather Durability
core_selling_points.description: Withstands full dust protection and temporary water immersion, operates reliably across extreme hot and cold environments.
core_selling_points.evidence: IP67 protection grade, operating temperature range of -40℃ to +40℃
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Show the monocular being splashed with water, placed in a snowy environment, and exposed to direct hot sunlight to demonstrate ruggedness.

core_selling_points.title: Customizable User Observation Experience
core_selling_points.description: Accommodates different vision prescriptions and user eye preference, suitable for both left and right eye users without extra adjustments.
core_selling_points.evidence: Left/right eye interchangeable observation, -6SD to +4SD diopter adjustment range, 25mm eye relief
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Show two separate users, one left-eye dominant and one right-eye dominant, both using the monocular comfortably.

core_selling_points.title: Built-in Safety & Auxiliary Lighting Features
core_selling_points.description: Protects users' eyes from sudden strong light damage, with auxiliary lighting to improve visibility in extra dark small areas.
core_selling_points.evidence: Built-in strong light protection and auxiliary lighting functional features
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Demo sequence showing the monocular auto-dimming when exposed to sudden bright light, then the auxiliary light turning on in pitch black conditions.

usage_scenarios.context: Security personnel conduct regular perimeter patrols of industrial parks, residential communities, or construction sites in low-light or full night conditions.

usage_scenarios.visual_hint: Show a uniformed security guard wearing the monocular mounted on their patrol helmet, clearly identifying a person approaching from 100m away at night.

usage_scenarios.context: Hunters track, observe, and identify game targets in woodlands or open fields during legal night hunting trips without disturbing wildlife.

usage_scenarios.visual_hint: Show a hunter holding the monocular while standing in a dark woodland, spotting a deer in the distance without using any visible bright light.

hero.scene_description:
PRODUCT: Matte black night vision device, kept true to original shape, color and size proportions, visible control buttons and lens, positioned as the clear central focal point.
ATMOSPHERE: Set at a dim residential community perimeter on a no-moon late night, soft warm side light comes from distant security street lamps, blurred background of shrubs and low boundary walls matches real patrol use scenarios.
LAYOUT: Product occupies 48% of the square frame, placed exactly at the center. Hook headline spans the entire top band, three benefit bullets are placed evenly at upper right, lower left, and lower right around the product, no overlapping elements, total text area accounts for less than 32% of frame height.
TYPOGRAPHY: Hook uses condensed bold italic sans-serif in bright neon green, 2.7x the height of proof text. Benefit names use semi-bold geometric sans in neon green, proof text uses regular sans in light gray, strictly following the size hierarchy Hook >> Name > Proof.
DECOR: No icons, badges, CTA buttons or leader lines added, only thin subtle hairline dividers between each benefit zone to keep sections clear, ample clean negative space around all elements with no extra decorative clutter.

detail.scene_description:
PRODUCT: The low-light observation device retains its original shape, color and proportions, optically centered in the mid-frame at 45% of canvas width, with a soft natural shadow for a grounded feel, no flat studio paste-on effect.
ATMOSPHERE: Set at a residential community perimeter right after sunset, warm soft side light illuminates the scene, with surrounding trees and paved walkway visible in the background, matching night patrol use scenarios.
LAYOUT: 3:4 portrait canvas with 4% safe margin on all edges, top 20% kept clear for overlay text, middle 50% holds the product hero, bottom 30% is a seamless smooth paved walkway with no painted panels, gutters or divider lines.
TYPOGRAPHY: No text, numbers or glyphs are painted on the base; all headline, subhead, story copy and icons will be added later via system overlay.
DECOR: No pre-painted icons, badges or decorative marks on the base; only subtle natural details like small fallen leaves on the bottom walkway surface, no artificial accent elements.
